title: allocasuarina humilis
intro: Allocasuarina humilis, commonly known as Dwarf Sheoak or Red Ironbark, is a small to medium-sized tree native to eastern Australia. The health benefits of Allocasuarina humilis include its potential to support cardiovascular health and lower cholesterol levels due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues, fever, and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of Allocasuarina humilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
